schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE dipartimenti (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    parent_id INT,
    descrizione TEXT,
    data_creazione TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    budget NUMERIC(12,2) CHECK (budget >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_parent FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES dipartimenti(id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_self_reference CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id)
);
